input.prompt: ONE photorealistic PRODUCTION REFERENCE SHEET, horizontal 16:9, split into THREE equal vertical panels side by side with thin white gutters, all three showing the SAME object or place with identical design, materials and colours. STUDIO: every panel on the same plain light-grey seamless studio backdrop and grey floor, soft even key light with a gentle fill and a soft contact shadow, product-catalogue clarity, nothing else in frame. THE ASSET: the smartphone from image 2 (unbranded graphite-grey phone, thin flat edges, clear slim case, the lilac-and-pink star sticker on the back, NO logo anywhere) with its screen ON and displaying EXACTLY the app screen in image 1, the Bolly Eats 'Order confirmed' screen: masala-maroon top with the yellow steam marks and 'bolly eats.' logo, a yellow tick circle, 'Order confirmed', 'Your feast is on its way.', then the cream lower half with 'ARRIVING IN 25 min', the four-step tracker and the order list. Reproduce the screen layout, colours and words exactly, bright and legible, with a faint natural screen reflection. PANEL 1 (left): phone standing upright, screen straight to camera. PANEL 2 (middle): phone propped on a small stand at a slight three-quarter angle, screen still readable. PANEL 3 (right): phone lying flat, seen from above at an angle, screen glowing. Real photography, true-to-life colour, subtle film grain, natural imperfections, believable and lived-in, not a render, not a cartoon. No people, no hands, no watermark.
